2607.20402.title: SoftReason: A Fully Differentiable Neuro-Soft-Symbolic Deductive Reasoning Architecture over High-Dimensional Perceptual Data
2607.20402.paper_summary: In many reasoning problems, the premises are not observed as discrete symbols, but must be inferred from high-dimensional inputs. Further, the predicate vocabulary, argument structure, and trusted evidence are supplied by a Knowledge Graph (KG), or rule definitions. Classical neuro-symbolic pipelines have a discrete interface between perception and deduction. We present a neuro-soft-symbolic architecture for differentiable deductive reasoning over latent perceptual facts and knowledge-provided predicates. SoftReason removes the gradient gap by representing the deductive state as a local soft interpretation tensor over candidate constants and predicates. Perception proposes probabilistic base facts, KG triples enter as high-confidence soft evidence, and every query anchor, predicate choice, and closure update remains differentiable. Our core innovation is a learned differentiable lift of the immediate-consequence operator. It uses predicate-definition embeddings and latent composition channels to form soft body-predicate mixtures, aggregate over all possible witnesses, propose query-conditioned head facts, and update the interpretation through a monotone probabilistic OR. We instantiate the framework on Knowledge-aware Visual Question Answering (KVQA), and demonstrates how SoftReason supports end-to-end perceptual grounding, KG evidence injection, and differentiable deductive closure in one trainable architecture.
2607.20402.paper_summary_zh: 在許多推理問題中，前提並不是作為離散符號被觀察到的，而必須從高維輸入中推斷出來。進一步地，謂詞詞彙、論證結構和可信證據由知識圖譜（KG）或規則定義提供。傳統的神經符號管道在感知和推理之間有一個離散的介面。我們提出了一種神經軟符號架構，用於對潛在感知事實和知識提供的謂詞進行可微分的推理。SoftReason 通過將推理狀態表示為候選常數和謂詞上的局部軟解釋張量來消除梯度差距。感知提出概率基礎事實，KG 三元組作為高置信度的軟證據進入，每個查詢錨點、謂詞選擇和閉包更新保持可微分。我們的核心創新是學習的可微分提升即時後果運算子。它使用謂詞定義嵌入和潛在組合通道來形成軟體謂詞混合，對所有可能的見證進行聚合，提出查詢條件的頭部事實，並通過單調概率 OR 更新解釋。我們在知識驅動的視覺問題回答（KVQA）上實現了該框架，並展示了 SoftReason 如何在一個可訓練的架構中支持端到端的感知基礎、KG 證據注入和可微分推理閉包。
2607.20402.author: Wael AbdAlmageed et.al.
